marketing_wrapper: Heavy. 01, 02 and 05 are lifestyle photography with a hand-held phone (screen tilted and partly unreadable) or a card on a receipt tray, plus a floating money card on 05. 03, 04 and 06 are cleaner: purple #8e0de3 or cream backdrop, bold caption, realistic iPhone frame with a purple offset block behind it, ~55-60% UI. 04 overlays a marketing feature list card over the bottom of the UI.

typography.display: NuSans Display: heavy, tightly tracked rounded-terminal grotesk in captions (cream on purple, purple on cream)
typography.body: custom: NuSans Text (consistent with the brand-refresh description)
typography.numerals: lining, bold for balances; tabular unsure
typography.weights: Balances bold; labels regular in muted purple-grey; buttons semibold
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case; tight negative tracking on display; normal on body

palette.accent_strategy: One owned purple used sparingly in UI (logo token, caret, confirm button, card art, icon tints); semantic green only for earnings. The purple floods the marketing wrapper, not the screens.
palette.source: palette.json 04 and 06 (#8e0de3 31-46% backdrop, matched to in-app confirm button and logo), 03 (#ffffff 40% UI canvas), 02 (#260f3b aubergine text/header); caption cream #f2f0ef from 01

shape.radius_language: large and pill: segmented control and action buttons full pills/circles, cards ~20pt, card art ~12pt
shape.borders_shadows: Hairline outlines plus very soft shadow on circular action buttons and the Unfreeze pill; hairline dividers
shape.materials: Frost/ice texture overlay on the frozen card (state shown as material); 02 home cards look translucent but the photo is too blurred to judge

liquid_glass_visible: unclear: 02 home cards appear translucent over a purple header, but the device is tilted and soft-focus
density: low; one balance, three actions, a disclaimer on the account screen
layout: Account screen: back + eye (hide balance) + more in top bar, Spend/Save segmented control, centred nu token, label, big balance, earnings line, APY chip, three circular outlined actions (Deposit, Transfer, Send). Card screen: card art, Unfreeze pill, copyable detail fields.
navigation: Back chevron and close X in nav bars; segmented control for sub-accounts; no tab bar visible
imagery_and_icons: Thin outline arrow icons; 3D-rendered purple illustration (wallet, cards, coins) for cashback; lifestyle photography in wrapper; frost texture on frozen card
signature_visual_move: Freezing a card covers the card art with a frost texture, so the state is shown as a material change.
tells_present: Gestalt sameness: centred balance over round labelled action buttons
Purple, indigo, violet (owned here; flags a false-positive risk for the tell)

direction_fit.why: Owned flat purple, custom NuSans, 3D illustration system, and an in-app UI that keeps purple to tokens and the confirm button. The Ultravioleta Private-Bank Editorial variant does not appear in these US screenshots.

notes: MONEY ANATOMY. Balance: '$1,200.00' bold, ~3x body, centred under a regular muted label 'Spending balance' and a purple circular nu token (a circle here, not the square container the brand post describes). Cents same size and weight; $ full size, no space. Earnings: '▲ $10.00 earned to date' in green with filled triangle; '3.50% APY' in a mint pill. Tabular: unsure. A secondary small line shows '$ 2,394.08' with a space after $, inconsistent with the main balance. Amount entry (international transfer): 'USD 100.00' with the ISO code in grey medium and the amount in black medium, ~1.7x body, left-aligned with a purple caret and a flag; recipient row 'BRL 520.00' with a flag dropdown; rate row '1 USD = 5.20 BRL' with a refresh spinner 'Updating in 15 min'; confirm is a purple circular check button. No negative amounts or charts shown; 02 shows a credit-card progress bar in purple. Cashback card: '$50.23' bold under a 3D illustration.
